newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni, Enel in talks over joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Eni, Enel in talks over joint venture.

text.p: Italian energy giant Eni and state controlled electricity utility Enel said on Friday they were in talks over the creation of a joint venture for the production of electricity using turbogas technology.
Italian financial magazine Il Mondo said in an article to be published on Saturday that the negotiations are at an advanced stage, adding that a foreign partner might join the venture.
Spokesmen at both Eni and Enel confirmed that talks were under way but declined to give further details.
Il Mondo said the deal would involve electricity production plants already on line, adding that much of the gas would come from Nigeria.
Enel has a contract to buy 3.5 billion cubic metres of Nigerian natural gas a year for the next 25 years, but does not have the capacity in Italy to process all the gas. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
